# docs/ System — Quick Reference

claude-kit uses a lightweight documentation system. Research and architecture
decisions live in the repo. Requirements are tracked as GitHub Issues with the
`requirement` label.

## Directory Structure

```
docs/
├── research/          Theoretical papers and exploration
├── architecture/
│   ├── decisions/     Architecture Decision Records (ADR-XXX)
│   └── components/    Component documentation
├── specs/             Version-scoped implementation specs (SPEC-XXX)
├── quality/           Quality attributes (QA-XXX)
└── methodology/       Engineering guides (derivation, evidence, coverage)
```

## When to Consult

| You are about to... | Check first |
|---------------------|-------------|
| Start a new feature | GitHub Issues labeled `requirement`, `docs/specs/` for active SPECs |
| Make an architecture decision | `docs/architecture/decisions/` for prior ADRs on the same topic |
| Prepare a release | `docs/specs/` for active SPECs |
| Change a core subsystem | `docs/architecture/components/` for component documentation |
| Check engineering methodology | `docs/methodology/` for derivation rules, evidence standards |

## When to Update

| You just... | Update |
|-------------|--------|
| Made an architecture decision | Create a new ADR (never edit accepted ADRs) |
| Completed a spec | Set SPEC status to `completed` |

## ADR Immutability Rule

**Never edit an accepted ADR.** To change a decision:

1. Create a new ADR with the next sequential ID
2. Explain in its Context section why the original is being revisited
3. Update the original's status to `superseded-by ADR-YYY` (the **only** allowed edit)

## Validation

```bash
bash scripts/validate-docs.sh               # Layer 4 — docs structure
```
